title: Sam Altman says it’s better for RAM to be in a data center than on your desk
script:
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman thinks your personal computer RAM is a waste.
He says keeping memory in data centers is better than having it on your desk.
Altman shared this view during a recent appearance on the Cheeky Pint podcast.
He described the current distribution of hardware as terrible for scaling AI.
The industry is currently facing a massive global shortage of high-speed memory modules.
Altman argues that centralized cloud computing is the only way forward for AI.
Would you trade your PC speed for pure cloud access?
